stories.title: What really happened in Ceuta? Why we may never find out
stories.description: Hundreds of migrants have again attempted to cross from Morocco into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. This time, Moroccan officials fended them off, raising new questions about the crossing of July 30.

stories.title: Many Iranians are heading to Turkey to escape the ongoing war's heavy toll
stories.description: Iranians visiting the city of Van, Turkey, near the Iranian border say how expensive and difficult life back home is.

stories.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

stories.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
stories.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war
stories.description: Iran's proxy says it hit a ship with Saudi military equipment in the Red Sea, as tensions over the US-Iran war remain high.

stories.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
stories.description: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

stories.title: Houthis launch new attacks on al-Makha and Marib as Yemen conflict escalates
stories.description: Houthi missile and drone strikes target Marib and al-Makha, killing at least four people and injuring eight.

stories.title: ‘Limited options’ for many Iranians as war with US chokes economy
stories.description: Millions of Iranians struggle to make ends meet as war with US devastates the economy and sends prices soaring.

stories.title: Trump threatens to make the Strait of Hormuz a US territory: Can he?
stories.description: US president has yet another outlandish threat for Iran, with no end to war in sight.

stories.title: Why has Israel escalated attacks in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire?
stories.description: At least 11 people killed in one day of Israeli attacks despite truce extension brokered by US in June.

stories.title: Israel vows to go after Hezbollah as it names another killed
stories.description: "No score will be left unsettled in any arena. We'll defend our soldiers and our civilians with full power," Defence Minister Israel Katz

stories.title: Iran offers $30,000 bounty for killing, capturing U.S. soldiers
stories.description: There has been no known deployment of U.S. ground forces in Iran during the West Asia war, except for a rescue mission in April for a downed American airman

stories.title: West Asia war LIVE: Pope calls for an end to West Bank violence against Palestinians
stories.description: Israeli strikes on August 15 killed 11 people in southern Lebanon, according to authorities, in the deadliest attacks since a deal was reached in June aimed at ending hostilities

stories.title: Iran executes man over involvement in winter protests
stories.description: Iranian authorities reported more than 3,000 deaths, attributing the violence to "terrorist acts" orchestrated by the United States and Israel, while rights groups based abroad maintain that security forces fired on protesters

stories.title: Iran fires back at Trump's threat to declare Hormuz a U.S. territory
stories.description: Mr. Trump has repeatedly said the strait, which Tehran effectively closed at the start of the West Asia war in late February, is under U.S. control an assertion the Islamic Republic denies

stories.title: West Asia war highlights: Iran fires back at Trump’s threat to declare Hormuz a U.S. territory
stories.description: Lebanon reports 11 dead in strikes that Israel says targeted Hezbollah; Iran demands release of downed pilots as Qatar denies holding them

stories.title: Western sanctions only heighten interest to business contacts with Russia — Kremlin aide
stories.description: Western sanctions have heightened interest in business networking among business representatives at major international events in Russia, such as the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF) and the Russian Economic Week, Russian Presidential Aide and Executive Secreta...

stories.title: White House contacted IRGC via mediator who has offered assistance again - media
stories.description: The United States wanted to organize closed-door bilateral settlement talks in Iraqi Kurdistan’s administrative center, the city of Erbil

stories.title: Yemeni army reports over 180 operations against Houthis in past day
stories.description: According to the Yemeni army spokesman Colonel Majed Al-Nuzaili, dozens of Ansar Allah rebels were killed, their numerous weapons systems and arms depots were eliminated

stories.title: Iran estimates environmental damage from Hormuz oil spill at trillions of dollars
stories.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said that everyone involved in commercial shipping operations must bear legal and moral responsibility for clearing the aftermath in the region
